name: Washington Metal Fabricators
old_description: As more than just a typical "job shop," Washington Metal Fabricators is an engineering firm that specializes in optimizing manufacturing processes. While we don’t design products, we partner with our clients to refine their designs and determine the most cost-effective and efficient manufacturing strategies. We meticulously review every aspect of your product, ensuring it’s built with precision, delivered to market swiftly, and priced competitively.
about:
Washington Metal Fabricators operates from Washington, Missouri, about 50 miles southwest of St. Louis. The company was founded in 1979 and has served as a manufacturing cornerstone in the region for over four decades. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The firm positions itself as an engineering-focused partner rather than a conventional job shop, specializing in optimizing manufacturing processes for clients. Its 154,000-square-foot campus includes a 50,000-square-foot assembly and distribution center. Equipment spans tube and sheet laser cutting (four Trumpf lasers, Trumpf 7000 tube laser), CNC punching, nine brake presses (38–175 tons), three coil-fed stamping lines, three rolling centers, 15 welding stations (manual and robotic, including a Genesis Versa2), 15 grinding stations, and a Nordson powder-coat line with custom finishes such as wood grain and corten. Services range from product consulting, 2D/3D CAD, and prototyping through fabrication, welding, finishing, assembly, and warehousing, supporting both prototype and high-volume runs.

The company serves customers from small local shops to Fortune 500 manufacturers across sectors including electrical enclosures, machine components, power-grid transformer tanks, OEM components, and HVAC products. It also collaborates with its sister company, EZ Fabricating, to incorporate non-metal materials and provide inventory management.

Washington Metal Fabricators was built on the principle that diverse equipment investment enables the most efficient manufacturing route for each part. By reviewing every aspect of a client’s design, the firm aims to deliver precision, speed to market, and competitive pricing without designing the product itself.
